name: Michigan 4-H Exploration Days (at Michigan State University)
org: Michigan State University Extension, Michigan 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Stay on the MSU campus with about 1,000 other youth and choose from more than 100 sessions taught by MSU faculty, staff and 4-H volunteers. You live in a dorm and eat in the dining hall.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 12 to 19 (the listing shows grades 6 to 12). The listing says to check with your county MSU Extension office about scholarship funds.
pay_detail: 2025 cost was $250 and a 2026 cost is not posted on the page. It covers meals, a shared dorm room, sessions and a t-shirt. Your county MSU Extension office may have scholarship money.
deadline_text: The 2026 event was June 24 to 26, 2026. 2027 dates and the 2026 price are not posted on the listing I could read.
how_to_apply: The listing links to a program page for details and registration, which I could not read. Contact on the listing: Michelle Neff, hydemich@msu.edu, 989-539-7805.
notes: The program's own 4-H page did not load for me. The Michigan State University College of Agriculture and Natural Resources site blocks automated readers. So this card rests on Michigan State University's Spartan Youth Programs listing only. Confirm dates, price and how to register on the 4-H page. It is a statewide event held in East Lansing, so it may also be listed as a Michigan-wide card. Not a job.
